description: This file sets up and renders the root component ('App') of a React.js web application into the DOM element with id 'root'. It imports necessary dependencies including React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React application into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React application within the root element, wrapping it in React.StrictMode.
